items.title: Bill Goodwin interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 28, 2025
items.q: we were going to have the quintet with Brian Lynch, Phil, and Bill Charlap, Steve Gilmore and myself.

ctx.x: Or really more esperential. Yeah it happens. Those are scenes where you get prepared to do a recording. I like to do live recordings a lot and there was one we were going to do in New York at a club with Phil and I had it all set up. We had a really great relationship with Bruce Lundvall in these last years when he was at Blue Note. We became very

friendly over the years and I wanted to do a — we had done — I’d done some records for Bruce for Blue Note but I hadn’t done Phil’s group. I said you know we could do something with Phil. And he said that maybe that was a good idea but he didn’t know. So then we were going to do a thing at this club in New York called The Iridium and we were going to have the quintet with Brian Lynch, Phil, and Bill Charlap, Steve Gilmore and myself. We had a guest, Bob Dorough and Jon Gordon the alto player, the young alto…
